new_assertions.title: strong intrinsic-future obstruction interpretation is falsified
new_assertions.body: The representation graph has a genuine non-exact Z2 cochain, but every sheet pair used by its unique repair-surviving contradictory witness collapses under complete literal-future behavior. Therefore that witness does not establish a non-exact cocycle on literal future-behavior states.
new_assertions.scope: repair-surviving witness versus declared representation graph

new_assertions.title: specific-edge mechanism search is ill-posed before gauge fixing
new_assertions.body: Because the delta-1 location changes under node-local sheet gauge while route parity difference does not, an explanation targeted at the stored middle edge cannot be an invariant explanation unless it first introduces an independently justified gauge/transition coordinate.

new_assertions.title: old gravity-relative canonical-slot interpretations require transport
new_assertions.body: Because arbitrary canonical slots are not fixed physical columns and residual hyperedges may be non-geometric in the displayed frame, any claim tying a witness feature to physical gravity-relative column geometry requires an explicit accumulated transporter to a physical frame.

new_assertions.title: basis count and edge location cannot jointly supply invariant mechanism coordinates
new_assertions.body: Both the number of nonzero fundamental-basis cycles and the edge location of a local delta-1 are representation choices (cycle basis and sheet gauge respectively), while exactness and route-parity difference survive. Therefore mechanism hypotheses must be formulated in terms of basis/gauge-invariant structure.

new_assertions.title: transporter-aware reconstruction is the next necessary falsifier
new_assertions.body: The strongest unresolved alternative is whether any nontrivial fiber/non-exact holonomy survives after recursive action labels are aligned through edge transporters or the carrier is kept in a fixed/physical symmetry frame. Further explanation of the old witness before this reconstruction would reason about a distinction already falsified at literal-future resolution.

new_assertions.title: cap-hole clue is not yet a physical-game mechanism
new_assertions.body: The cap-hole motif is relabeling-covariant inside the abstract residual-hypergraph carrier, but the witness canonical frames are not physical frames and the stronger endpoint scalar bit has flat counterexamples. Thus the motif remains a soft representation-level clue until transporter-aware or physical-frame evidence is supplied.

Existing 3+3 minimum is an MSS of the declared representation graph, not an MSS of an intrinsic game-state obstruction.
